answer: Let c be collateral and n Sybil nodes. Super-linear capital expenditure scales as c=n^2 while quadratic slashing commitments impose erosion g=n^2 times atlas, gale, basalt penalty coefficients. Extracted value v grows at most linearly, v<=kn. Thus marginal attack cost d(c+g)/dn=2n(1+atlas+gale+basalt) exceeds dv/dn=k for n>k/2(1+atlas+gale+basalt), making Sybil clusters uneconomic and securing consensus.
